week_review.review_text:
WHAT HAPPENED:
The engine issued a High confidence Strongly Bearish bias on ES, but price rose +0.39% over the week. Strong rebounds on Thursday (+134) and Friday (+40) completely erased the midweek decline.

WHY IT MISSED:
The engine misread a 14,388 contract decrease in commercial net short positioning as bearish deterioration rather than bullish short covering. Furthermore, assigning High confidence while commercial positioning sat at a 100% range extreme ignored positioning exhaustion, declaring a strong sell signal just as commercial short exposure was actively contracting.

SUGGESTED IMPROVEMENT:
Suggest reviewing engine rules to require a confidence downgrade from High to Low whenever commercial net short exposure is decreasing from a 100% percentile extreme.

week_review.review_text:
WHAT HAPPENED:
The macro bearish call correctly predicted the week's net decline (-0.34%), but the engine failed on daily regime reads, missing four out of five morning calls due to large intra-week swings.

WHY IT MISSED:
High confidence was assigned despite conflicting short-term inputs: commercials reduced net shorts by 4,011 contracts alongside a bullish nodule. Because positioning percentiles (53% six-month, 68% twelve-month) were mid-range rather than at bearish extremes, this weekly short-covering directly fueled Thursday's violent 1,036-point rally and threw off daily AM regime classifications.

SUGGESTED IMPROVEMENT:
Automatically cap the engine's macro confidence score at Medium when week-over-week commercial flow direction explicitly opposes the multi-month program bias.
